# FLOW regression snapshots

These Apache-2.0 fixtures preserve the FLOW candidate used by Jig's parser and authoring regression tests.
FLOW owns the canonical [schema](https://github.com/jiggy/flow/blob/main/docs/flow/spec/machine/schema-0.json),
[invocation vectors](https://github.com/jiggy/flow/blob/main/conformance/run-0/fixtures/invocation-features.json),
and [authoring example](https://github.com/jiggy/flow/blob/main/packages/flow-authoring/test/fixtures/progress.tsp).

Update these snapshots deliberately when Jig adopts changed FLOW semantics.
They are test evidence and are never published as Jig's normative FLOW specification.
See [Apache-2.0](../../../../../LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt).
